content.title: Prime Video Cancels ‘The Runarounds’
content.text: Skip to main content site categories Home TV TV News Prime Video Cancels ‘The Runarounds’ The coming-of-age drama hailed from 'Outer Banks' creators Jonas and Josh Pate, who formed a real-life rock band to star at the center of the musical coming-of-age drama. 'The Runarounds': Topher (Jeremy Yun), Charlie (William Lipton) and Neil (Axel Ellis). Prime Video The Runarounds has been canceled after one season at Prime Video. The news comes after the installment dropped on the streamer in the beginning of September, with no word on its future since. The coming-of-age drama hailed from Outer Banks creators Jonas and Josh Pate, who formed a real-life rock band to star at the center of the musical coming-of-age drama. William Lipton, Axel Ellis, Jeremy Yun, Zendé Murdock and Jesse Golliher starred as the band on the show, and they are currently on tour offscreen. The group was formed in 2021 after Jonas issued a casting call for a group to appear on the Netflix hit Outer Banks. Lilah Pate, Maximo Salas, Kelley Pereira, Marley Aliah, Mark Wystrach, Brooklyn Decker, Hayes MacArthur and Shea Pritchard rounded out the season one cast. Related Stories “Today, we found out as many of you did that The Runarounds TV show will not be coming back for a season 2,” the band wrote on Instagram. “First and foremost we want you to know that while the TV sieres may have come to a close, as a band we’re here to stay. This is merely the end of one chapter and the beginning of a new one. We want to extend a massive thank you to everyone who helped in creating the first season of the show, from our cast and crew to everyone behind the scenes who believed in this and brought it to life.” Jonas previously told The Hollywood Reporter he had a five-season plan for The Runarounds. Season two would have followed the group in a “super crappy van on the regional tour playing colleges and 200 capacity rooms” as they worked to performing at a premium festival, before ending with them opening at Bonnaroo. He had plans for season three to track the group opening for another band on a European tour before the fourth installment would position them as “a headliner with 5,000 capacity rooms and all the pressures and issues with fame.” Season five, then, would have captured the band on a stadium tour. Jonas explained, “The dream is can I legitimately take this all the way and feel like you actually were in the van with them.” A synopsis for The Runarounds read: “Over the course of one unforgettable summer, they throw themselves into the pursuit of their big break — falling in love, getting into trouble and building the kind of bonds that feel like family along the way. With original music, romantic entanglements and the raw highs and lows of coming-of-age, The Runarounds captures the rush of risking everything at the edge of adulthood to chase your dreams.” The series was produced by Amazon MGM Studios and Skydance Television. The executive producer credits are shared by Jonas Pate, Joon Yun, David Wilcox, Josh Pate, Shannon Burke, Scott Lambert, Lisa Mae Fincannon, David Ellison, Dana Goldberg and Matt Thunell.
